title: Abbas Bohot dushwari hai
body:
Abbas Bohot dushwari hai
MERA ABBAS BHAIYYA ABBAS, MERA ABBAS BHAIYYA ABBAS.
<<DIVIDER>>
ABBAS BOHOT DUSHWARI HAI, ABBAS BOHOT DUSHWARI HAI
ZENAB NE KAHA ROKAR BHAYYA SAR KHULNE KI TAYYARI HAI, ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
BADHTA HAI MERI JANIB LASHKAR AA JALDI AA DAR TAARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOTDUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
1- AAKHIR ME KAROO’N KY BATLA DE..KOI RAH TO MUJHKO DIKHLA DE
AISA NA HO MUJHPAR DHAYE’N SITAM..ME KON HOON INKO SAMJHA DE
SUNTI HOO’N KE TERI DARYA PAR *2,  IS WAQT ALAMBARDARI HAI.
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOTDUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
2- KYUN LETA NAHI HAI MERI KHABAR..ME HO GAEIN HOO’N GHAR SE BE GHAR
DARTI HOO’N NA CHHIN JAYE CHADAR..HAI DEKH QAYAMAT KA MANZAR
KYUN KARTA NAHI IMDAAD MERI *2, KYA BAAT HAI JO BE ZAARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
3- KYA ISSE BADA BHI HOGA SITAM…AB NARGHA E AADA ME HAIN HAM
SAANSE’N HAIN GALE ME ATKI HUI LAGTA HAI NIKAL JAYEGA DAM
KARTI HAI SAKINA YAAD TUJHE *2, GHABRAEI HUI BECHARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
4- KHEMO KO JALAYA JAATA HAI..BE JURM SATAYA JAATA HAI
AA DEKH MERE GHAZI QAIDI…AABID KO BANAYA JAATA HAI
PEHNATE HAIN ZALIM ZANJEERE’N *2,  AUR TAUQ GALE ME  BHAARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
5- AISE ME KARE KYA TERI BAHAN…BANDHTI HAI MERE SHANO ME RASAN
KIS TARHA RAKHOO’N DIL PAR QABU..KIS TARHA KAROO’N YE ZULM SAHAN
GHAIRAT SE MERA PHATTA HAI JIGAR *2, SAANSO’N ME BHI AAHO ZAARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
6- KISTARHA JIYE’N NAAZO’N KE PALE..HAIN AIK RASAN ME 12 GALE
HASTE HAIN MERI GHURBAT PE LAEE’N..DIN YE BHI MERI TAQDEER ME THE
ZINDA MUJHE BHAYYA RAKKHE HUYE *2, IS WAQT MERI KHUDDARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
7- KODO’N PE ME KODE KHAATI HOO’N…AUR KUCHH BHI NAHI KEH PAATI HOO’N
JAB DEKHTI HOO’N NEZO’N PE SAR…DIL THAM KE BAS REH JAATI HOO’N
HOTE HAI MUSALSAL ZULM O SITAM *2, GHURBAT KA SAFAR BHI JAARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
8- EY TISHNA JIGAR EY TISHNA DAHAA’N..EY SHERE GHAZNFAR RAAHAT E JAA’N
ITNA TO BATA DE ZENAB KO MANZIL HAI KAHA’N JANA HAI KAHA’N
BITHHLATE HAIN ZALIM NAAQE PAR *2  KIS ZULM KI YE TAYYARI HAI
<<MINI>>
ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
<<DIVIDER>>
9- ASIF JO SUKHAN ZENAB KE SUNE..ABBAS LABE DARYA TADPE
SHABBIR KA SAR ROYA AAMIR..AANKHO’N KO NA KHOLA GHAZI NE ..
KEHTI RAHI KHAHAR RO ROKAR *2  IMDAAD KO AA LAACHARI
<<MINI>>
HAI ABBAS BAHOT DUSHWARI HAI *2
MERA ABBAS BHAIYYA ABBAS, MERA ABBAS BHAIYYA ABBAS.
<<DIVIDER>>
